lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region, extending towards the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of spots, forming a visible rectilinear grid pattern in the sub-dorsal flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features along the upper lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with light intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 5-7 distinct white spots distributed across the visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, high-intensity spots on the leading edge and distal third of the visible pectoral fin surface.
